_what: The email formats as stacks of sections (EMAIL-FORMATS.md). Each section is one of the 17 names in SECTIONS.md; each picture slot is S scene (made from a real reference) · P product (real, placed) · D detail (made from a real macro reference) · R proof (real, as-is). section_email.py lays an email out from this file. Built 2026-10-08 on the owner's word: 'think about email design just like we think about landing page design'.
